Whether it’s to improve their talents in preparation for our fall show, or to simply join us for some summer fun, your junior actor is welcome here! Musical theater camps at AJT are great for making friends, developing a stronger sense of self-confidence and strengthening performing chops by exploring choreography, scenes and songs from hit musicals and movies.

Camps are M-F 9 a.m. – 4:00 p.m. for kids ages 8-18 and M-F 9 a.m. – 12:00 p.m. for kids ages 4-7.

Asheville Music School

10 Ridgelawn RoadAsheville, NC 28806
Phone: 828-252-6244
Business Hours: 9am-9pmEmail: info@ashevillemusicschool.orgWebsite: Visit Website Google Map

Image Credit: AMS

Image Credit: AMS

Image Credit: AMS

Image Credit: AMS

The mission of Asheville Music School is strengthening communities through music education and outreach, while sustaining teachers and musicians in a vibrant music culture. At our West Asheville facility, more than 35 music educators conduct private lessons in a wide variety of music styles and instruments for students of all ages and abilities. We also offer band & ensemble classes, summer camps, group classes, master classes and workshops in a supportive family-friendly environment. Our instructors are professional music educators, many of whom also perform at local and regional venues. We strive to keep music education accessible for students by providing scholarships to those unable to afford music lessons, and we aim to keep music educators and teaching artists in business by providing affordable studio space. Launched as a community business in 1996, Asheville Music School transitioned to 501(c)(3) status in 2012, and is governed by a volunteer board of directors. The school, located on Beacham’s Curve in West Asheville, is open 7 days a week and lessons can be scheduled any time of the day or evening. Since its inception as a nonprofit, AMS has awarded more than $90,000 in need-based scholarships to those unable to afford private music lessons and summer camps. The Sound Education outreach program connects AMS students, faculty and underserved community members through free performances and group music classes for veterans, seniors, the homeless, people in recovery and those living with disabilities.

Song Circle Voice Camp
7/21/2025 - 7/25/2025
9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
$205
Ages: 8 - 11
Led by: Rachel Hansbury
Come join the singing fun in Song Circle camp! This camp provides a welcoming, supportive environment for singers (or wanna be singers!).
Beginning singers will be supported by group songs and get the chance to try their own voice in short, easy solos. Developing and more advanced singers can build their performance experience and learn techniques for harmony singing.
Each day will consist of learning songs as a group, with small solos or harmony sections. Songs will range from camp classics, pop and rock standards, Disney favorites, to contemporary hits. Additional rhythm and creativity activities will round out these fun, relaxing mornings.

Harry Potter-themed Suzuki Strings Camp
7/28/2025 - 8/1/2025
9:00 AM - 4:00 PM
$380
Ages: 5 - 12
Led by: Holley Ross, Paul Stroebel
Come join in on the magic, music, and merriment of Hogwarts Camp of Violin and Musicality. We will have wand practice, floating candles and other Hogwarts decorations, history of music, Quidditch, and plenty of music making from the Suzuki repertoire.

This camp is for string students with at least 1 year of Suzuki experience on their instrument.

Jazz Camp
7/28/2025 - 8/1/2025
9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
$205
Ages: 13 - 18
Led by: Ryan Kijanka, Andy John
Location: Trinity United Methodist (West Asheville)
Jazz Camp is a great place for the advancing musicians to learn how to play jazz. Reading music is recommended but not required. Available for all instrumentalists and singers, we will explore standard jazz repertoire and styles, music theory, improvisation, common jazz rhythms, phrasing, and song forms.
Audition video or interview may be needed upon request.

Open Jam Camp
8/11/2025 - 8/15/2025
9:00 AM - 12:00 PM
$205
Ages: 9-16
Led by: Mary Steinbrecher
Open Jam Camp is a great way to get started in the rock band setting. Any instrument welcome! Whether you're building confidence on your instrument, or you've been rocking out for years, this camp is a great way to expand your musical horizons and collaborate with your peers.
This camp will include a mini-workshop on recording and engineering techniques.

Wortham Center for the Performing Arts

18 Biltmore Ave.Asheville, NC 28801
Phone: 828-257-4530Email: boxoffice@worthamarts.orgWebsite: Visit Website Google Map

Located in the heart of the Pack Square Cultural District, the Wortham Center for the Performing Arts is a three-venue complex comprising Diana Wortham Theatre, Tina McGuire Theatre and Henry LaBrun Studio. The Wortham Center’s ever-popular annual season of national and international touring artists, Wortham Presents, offers live performances of the best in music, dance, theatre, comedy and special attractions. Past headliners include Ladysmith Black Mambazo, Pilobolus, Kathy Mattea, Black Violin, Paula Poundstone, Rhiannon Giddons, Béla Fleck, and DIAVOLO. Performances in the Wortham’s Student Series season align with the NC Public Schools systems curriculum and are attended by students, parents, and teachers from 16 counties in Western North Carolina. Additionally, a wide range of regional arts groups and organizations utilize the Wortham Center, including Different Strokes! Performing Arts Collective, The Asheville Ballet, Terpsicorps Theatre of Dance, Asheville Performing Arts Academy, Ballet Conservatory of Asheville, Music Video Asheville, The Moth Asheville, and Punch Bucket Literary Festival.

Calling all coders, engineers, scientists, explorers and designers! Discover how the world works and spark your child's curiosity in their Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math Summer Camps. Zaniac offers half-day and full-day camps for kids (ages 5-14) with one-week sessions running from June 12th through August 25th.

They engage your child's mind with interactive summer camps to explore, learn, research, experiment, and innovate. Use their cutting-edge tools to create projects and experiments led by role model instructors.

Black Mountain Center for the Arts (BMCA) is a vibrant hub for creativity, connection, and artistic expression in the heart of downtown Black Mountain, NC. Housed in a beautifully restored historic building, BMCA offers a diverse range of programs, performances, and workshops for all ages and skill levels. Our offerings include: 🎭 Performing Arts – Dance classes for all levels, theater performances, and live music events. 🎨 Visual Arts – Rotating gallery exhibitions, artist workshops, and community art projects. 🩰 Dance & Movement – From contemporary and jazz to yoga and creative movement, our classes welcome all ages and abilities. 🎶 Music & Events – Concerts, open mic nights, and special events celebrating local and regional talent. 🖌️ Ceramics & Pottery – A fully equipped clay studio offering classes and open studio hours for beginners and experienced potters alike. As a nonprofit, BMCA is dedicated to making the arts accessible to everyone, fostering creativity, and enriching the cultural landscape of our community. Whether you're looking to take a class, attend a performance, or simply explore the arts, BMCA is the place to be!

Black Mountain Centre for the Arts

225 West State StreetBlack Mountain, NC 28711
Phone: 8286690930
Business Hours: Monday - Friday, 10:00 AM - 5:00 PMEmail: info@blackmountainarts.orgWebsite: Visit Website Google Map

The Black Mountain Center for the Arts (BMCA) has been a cornerstone of artistic expression and community engagement in the Swannanoa Valley since its founding in 2000. Located in the charming town of Black Mountain, North Carolina, the Center offers an array of programming, including classes, exhibitions, performances, and events, designed to inspire creativity and bring people together. Mission and Vision: At its heart, BMCA is dedicated to its mission of bringing arts to the people and people to the arts. The Center serves as a vibrant hub where individuals of all ages and backgrounds can celebrate artistic endeavors and connect through shared experiences. Its programming is guided by a vision to honor the region’s rich heritage while introducing new and diverse art forms that foster dignity, respect, and joy. Programming and Offerings: BMCA provides opportunities for exploration and growth through a variety of offerings. The Center hosts art exhibitions that feature local, regional, and national artists, providing a platform for creative expression across a range of mediums. Classes in painting, pottery, music, dance, and more are open to beginners and seasoned artists alike, encouraging community members to discover or deepen their artistic passions. Performances and events further enrich the cultural fabric of Black Mountain. Concerts, theatrical productions, and spoken-word events bring world-class talent to the area, while workshops and lectures offer unique opportunities for learning and connection. BMCA’s annual calendar is thoughtfully curated to ensure something for everyone, making it a vital part of the community’s cultural life. Community Impact: The Center’s influence extends beyond the arts, contributing to the economic and social well-being of the Swannanoa Valley. By collaborating with local schools, businesses, and cultural organizations, BMCA enhances the area’s quality of life and fosters a strong sense of community. Its welcoming environment invites individuals to explore creativity, build relationships, and celebrate the transformative power of the arts. Looking Ahead: As BMCA continues to grow, its commitment to serving as a beacon for creativity and connection remains steadfast. By embracing innovation and staying attuned to the needs of its community, the Center aims to expand its reach and deepen its impact. Whether you’re an artist, a lifelong learner, or someone seeking inspiration, the Black Mountain Center for the Arts invites you to be part of its ongoing story—a story rooted in the beauty and joy of artistic expression.
